heading: Appeals & Dispute Resolution
subheading: Review official decisions, assess available resolution options, submit structured appeals or review requests, and track dispute proceedings under BIS conformity regulations.

decisionContext.title: Official Decision / Finding Under Scrutiny
decisionContext.noAppeal: This decision is in final status and not eligible for further dispute review.

resolutionPaths.title: Available Resolution Options
resolutionPaths.subtitle: Select an officially supported course of action based on your assessment of the decision:

APPEAL.title: Formal Appeal
APPEAL.description: File a statutory appeal before the Appellate Authority against license refusal, rejection, or cancellation.

REVIEW_REQUEST.title: Request for Review
REVIEW_REQUEST.description: Request re-evaluation of specific test parameters or scrutiny observations with clarifying technical data.

CLARIFICATION_REQUEST.title: Request Clarification
CLARIFICATION_REQUEST.description: Seek formal guidance on interpretation of standard clauses or technical test report observations.

GRIEVANCE.title: Grievance / Dispute Notice
GRIEVANCE.description: Lodge an administrative grievance regarding procedural delays, inspection conduct, or fee calculations.

ASSESSMENT_RESPONSE.title: Assessment Response
ASSESSMENT_RESPONSE.description: Submit a formal written response to non-conformity findings identified during factory surveillance or market sampling.

actions.withdrawConfirm: Are you sure you want to withdraw this request?

wizard.title: Dispute Resolution Wizard
wizard.step1Desc: Choose the type of issue you wish to dispute and the resolution path supported by the authority.
wizard.step2Desc: Provide a factual and clear statement explaining why this review or appeal is requested.
wizard.step3Desc: Attach technical test reports, calibrated lab certificates, or existing documents from Compliance Vault.
wizard.step4Desc: Verify all submission details before transmitting to the competent appellate authority.
wizard.step5Desc: Your request has been officially recorded in the BIS portal.
wizard.reasonPlaceholder: E.g., Discrepancy in ambient temperature test conditions during re-testing (IS 14543 Clause 6.1)...
wizard.explanationPlaceholder: Provide a comprehensive, factual explanation. State specific clauses, test methods, or procedural observations.
wizard.reasonMinLength: Explanation must be at least 30 characters.
wizard.neutralNotice: Note: Submissions are evaluated strictly against verified test records and applicable Indian Standards. Please ensure statements are factual and verifiable.
wizard.declarationText: I hereby declare that the information and evidence submitted herein are authentic, accurate, and reflect verifiable compliance records.
wizard.declarationRequired: You must confirm the declaration before submitting.
wizard.successMessage: Your resolution request has been transmitted. An official acknowledgment has been generated.

additionalInfo.title: Additional Information Requested
additionalInfo.deadlineNotice: Please respond by {{date}} to prevent administrative closure.
additionalInfo.responsePlaceholder: Enter your detailed response addressing the specific observations requested by the reviewing officer...
additionalInfo.successMessage: Additional information has been submitted successfully.

evidence.title: Supporting Evidence Documents
evidence.dropzoneTitle: Drag & drop supporting files here, or
evidence.dropzoneSub: PDF, DOCX up to 15MB. Calibrated test reports and QAP charts accepted.

empty.noActiveDesc: There are currently no active resolution requests or appeals associated with your applications.
empty.noHistoryDesc: No historical appeals or resolved dispute records found for this account.
empty.noOptionsDesc: There is currently no supported appeal or dispute action for this application.

errors.loadFailedDesc: We could not retrieve the latest appeal or dispute information from the server.
errors.submitFailedDesc: Your request could not be processed at this time. Please check your network connection and try again.
